source: Afromedia Plc audited accounts on the NGX filing library. FY2022 and FY2021 from the FY2022 annual report (doclib 39227, approved by the board 31 March 2023); FY2020 (15 months ended 31 December 2020) and FY2019 (year ended 30 September 2019) from the FY2020 annual report (doclib 33322), statement and five year summary; FY2018, FY2017 and FY2016 from the five year financial summary on page 65 of the FY2021 annual report (doclib 35538) and page 66 of the FY2020 annual report, which agree with each other. Filed in NGN thousands, stored here in absolute NGN. Fiscal year end moved from 30 September to 31 December, so FY2020 covers 15 months. | CRON 20261116: EPS row filled from figures printed in the audited filings, using the weighted average number of ordinary shares of 4,439,046,986 that note 33 of the FY2021 audited annual report states for 2021 AND 2020 (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/35538_AFROMEDIA_PLC%20_AUDITED_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2021_FI.pdf, page 55). FY2020 is the value the filing prints directly (basic earnings per ordinary share 0.12, page 18; 544,927,000 divided by the printed share count gives 0.1228, the stored 0.1227 rounds from the same arithmetic). FY2022, FY2021 and FY2019 to FY2017 are computed as profit for the year divided by that same printed share count, which is valid because share capital is unchanged at 2,757,278,000 in the FY2021 five year summary and in the FY2022 statement of financial position (no issue or buyback): -118,114,000/4,439,046,986 = -0.0266; -216,923,000/4,439,046,986 = -0.0489; 586,468,000/4,439,046,986 = 0.1321; 382,081,000/4,439,046,986 = 0.0861; 632,534,000/4,439,046,986 = 0.1425. FY2016 is left blank: the FY2016 column came from the FY2020 annual report five year summary, which is not in hand, and its share count is not verified for that year. Note that the FY2022 management report (page 3) presents FY2021 with a loss of 216,923 after reclassifying 361,159 of other operating income into other comprehensive income, so total comprehensive income is 144,236 in both presentations; the stored FY2021 rows follow the FY2022 presentation and the EPS here is on that same basis, not the 0.03 the FY2021 report printed on its pre-reclassification numbers.
note: EPS withheld: the filing labels its earnings per share line in kobo while the figure matches naira per share over 4,439,046,986 shares, so the unit cannot be settled.
